description:
Why would a team score an own goal—then defend both goals?

In a 1994 Caribbean Cup qualifier, Barbados needed more than a win. Their deliberate equalizer changed the incentives again: Grenada could qualify by scoring at either end.

The bizarre part makes sense once you see the rules.

Original illustrated reconstruction, not match footage. AI-generated narration.

#FootballHistory #CaribbeanCup #BarbadosGrenada
firstComment: The extra-time winner counted double. But before extra time, even a Grenada own goal could stop Barbados qualifying: they'd win by only one.
